title: Federation shutdown witness stalls behind its held receive and aborts through a poisoned control guard Drop
outcome: The past-writer receive/shutdown witness establishes stop and join ordering without relying on a worker that may be blocked by its own held receive, and control-guard teardown cannot turn a preceding failure into a process abort while preserving security retirement.
acceptance: The original Windows FULL failure, exact input and journal chain are preserved, and the shutdown scheduling cause is distinguished from the destructor abort using source and a discriminating controlled test; no timeout is inflated and no assertion is weakened.

The receive/shutdown witness deterministically proves stop-before-release, one admitted receive committed once, and executor joins before persistence; controlled error paths release owned gates so the test can report its first failure.

FederationControlGuard teardown remains fail-closed for its exact owner/incarnation and cannot panic again during unwinding from a poisoned link; regression coverage discriminates poison teardown, normal teardown and stale-owner isolation.

The separate repair candidate has a fresh complete review pair and relevant focused and maintained full gate evidence on its exact input before landing; the failed trie candidate is not treated as gated by this repair.
